sources.citation: Viegas Barros, J. Pedro (2009). "Otra lengua misteriosa". Post to the Etnolinguistica mailing list, Wed 18 Feb 2009. (Glottolog ref 115057, hh:w:ViegasBarros:Misteriosa -- the only Glottolog reference for guac1240.) https://listserv.linguistlist.org/pipermail/etnolinguistica/2009-February/
sources.note: Nothing. The post presents the entire known corpus of the presumed Guachipas language: two toponyms from a land-possession document of 21 Oct 1616 (reproduced in Zorreguieta 2008: 413-4) -- 'oma sacopo' glossed 'el seno de las Pirguas del Sol' and 'Rio mep' glossed 'Rio del Anta' -- plus speculative morphological discussion (possible genitive -p, possible Lule-Vilela affinity via Vilela mo- 'tapir'). No phonology, no accent marking, no stress statement.

sources.note: Not about Guachipas (concerns an unnamed two-word language of the Tembey river, Paraguay, from Ambrosetti 1896); fetched sources as the companion post to confirm which of the two 'lengua misteriosa' posts is the Guachipas one. Nothing on stress.
